name: Louisiana
source: Louisiana Act 11 of the 2024 third extraordinary session (flat 3 percent from 2025, standard deduction indexed to CPI-U from 2026); LDR 2026 withholding-table emergency rule (LAC 61:I.1501, standard deduction 12875/25750); R.S. 47:44.1 (retirement exclusion, read on legis.la.gov 2026-10-22); second sources EY Tax News 2024-2322, Kiplinger and Bloomberg Tax

state_base.note: Louisiana starts from federal adjusted gross (or taxable) income, so 401(k) deferrals, Traditional IRA deposits and HSA deposits stay deductible as on the federal return (confirmed primary: https://dam.ldr.la.gov/taxforms/IT540WEB-BC(2025) F.pdf, validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

standard_deduction.note: 2026 amounts the Louisiana Department of Revenue used for its 2026 withholding tables (12500/25000 for 2025 raised by the CPI-U); it says the amounts for 2026 returns may differ slightly. Head of household also gets 25750 (not modelled). No 65-or-older extra deduction for 2026: SB 240 (2025) died in committee and HB 667 stalled (https://legis.la.gov/LEGIS/BillInfo.aspx?i=248928, validation run 3, 2026-10-22).

retirement_exclusion.note: R.S. 47:44.1: 12000 of pension and annuity income per person aged 65 or older, adjusted by the CPI-U each year from 2026: 12,324 for tax year 2026 per spouse, also on separate returns (LDR notice of intent for LAC 61:I.1311, https://dam.ldr.la.gov/lawspolicies/NOI (Clean) LAC  61.I.1311 PDF.pdf, confirmed primary, validation run 2, 2026-10-22). Not modelled: the full exemption of federal, state and Louisiana public pensions and military retirement pay.

estate_inheritance.check_at: Louisiana R.S. 47:2401 to 47:2462 (inheritance tax repealed for deaths after 30 June 2004; estate transfer tax tied to the federal state death tax credit)
estate_inheritance.note: Louisiana has no estate tax and no inheritance tax: the inheritance tax was repealed for deaths after 30 June 2004 and the estate transfer tax depended on the federal state death tax credit, which ended in 2005 (state-costs.csv estate_tax and inheritance_tax 'none'; Tax Foundation 2026 map).

social_security.note: Louisiana does not tax Social Security benefits; it is not among the states that tax them in Kiplinger 2026 (https://www.kiplinger.com/taxes/states-that-tax-social-security-benefits) and AARP, as listed in .claude/state/research/state-costs.md. Confirmed primary on https://dam.ldr.la.gov/taxforms/IT540WEB-BC(2025) F.pdf (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

local_income_tax.check_at: Louisiana Constitution and LDR: no parish or municipal income tax on individuals
local_income_tax.note: Louisiana cities, parishes and counties levy no income tax on individuals (state-costs.csv local_income_tax 'none'; Tax Foundation local income tax map).

sales_tax.check_at: Louisiana revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: assumed equal to the combined rate. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.0) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: yes); research note: Food for home consumption exempt from state tax only; parish/municipal taxes apply; 2025 HB 229 (local exemption) not confirmed enacted. clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Some towns tax groceries and others do not; the estimate uses the general average local rate, so it overstates. Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Confirmed primary on the Census ACS 2024 1-year tables (https://data.census.gov/api/access/data/table?id=ACSDT1Y2024.B25090&g=040XX00US22, validation run 3, 2026-10-22). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.source: WalletHub, 2026's Property Taxes by State, vehicle tax table (https://wallethub.com/edu/t/states-with-the-highest-and-lowest-property-taxes/11585/), read 2026-10-22
car_taxes.note: Annual vehicle tax on a 29100 car (2026 Toyota Camry LE): registration licence tax of about 0.1 percent of value. One source, so unconfirmed; flat registration and title fees are not in it. Set by hand after .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py (which writes 0); rerunning the importer resets it. Confirmed primary on https://legis.la.gov/Legis/Law.aspx?d=102143 (validation run 2, 2026-10-22).

fuel.check_at: Louisiana motor fuel tax page and EIA gasoline prices (https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/)
fuel.source: Excise: USGasGauge/EIA (https://usgasgauge.com/gas-tax) and Kiplinger 2026 for some states, memory for the rest; price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel; average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Louisiana insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
